name: Attendance Summary
query:
SELECT
  ar.employee AS `Employee`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ar.status IN ('Present', 'Late') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `Present`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ar.status = 'Absent' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `Absent`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ar.status = 'Half Day' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `Half Day`,
  SUM(ar.overtime_hours) AS `Total Overtime Hrs`,
  COUNT(ar.name) AS `Total Days`,
  ROUND(
    SUM(CASE WHEN ar.status IN ('Present', 'Late') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(ar.name) * 100,
    1
  ) AS `Attendance %`
FROM `tabAttendance Record` ar
WHERE YEAR(ar.dated) = %(year)s
  AND MONTH(ar.dated) = %(month)s
  AND (%(employee)s IS NULL OR %(employee)s = '' OR ar.employee = %(employee)s)
GROUP BY ar.employee
ORDER BY ar.employee
